title: AI assistants (MCP)
description: Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor and other MCP clients on this computer can work with your projects as you do: look, create, train and check. Everything the AI does is visible in this window.

status.port_busy: Port {{port}} is used by another program. Choose another port.
status.failed: The server did not start. Details are in the application log.

port.label: Port
port.hint: The server listens on 127.0.0.1 only — other computers cannot connect.
port.invalid: The port is an integer from 1024 to 65535.

hint.read_only: The AI looks at projects, images and results but changes nothing.
hint.read_write: The AI creates and changes data and starts jobs but deletes nothing.
hint.full: The AI can do everything you can. Deleting a whole project is always confirmed in this window.

token.label: Access token
token.none: The token appears when the server is turned on for the first time.
token.regenerateHint: Connected clients stop working until you update their configuration.

config.title: Connect a client
config.claudeDesktop: Claude Desktop — through the stdio proxy
config.proxyMissing: The stdio proxy comes with the next build; the configuration already names its path.
config.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.

folders.restrict: Allow the AI only the chosen folders
folders.hint: Without the restriction the AI reads any file your Windows account can read — as a file dialog would.
folders.empty: No folders are chosen: the AI cannot read files from the disk.

launch.label: Start the application when the AI asks
launch.hint: When the application is closed, the stdio proxy starts it minimized to the notification area.

privacy: Images and data the AI looks at are sent to the model provider with the request. The MCP settings change only here — the AI cannot change them.

log.title: Call log
log.hint: The last 500 calls; they are also written to the application log.

confirm.title: An AI assistant asks for confirmation
confirm.expires: Without an answer the request is denied in {{seconds}} s.

actions.delete_project: Delete the project “{{name}}” with all its data from this computer. This cannot be undone.
actions.delete_project_jobs: Running jobs: {{jobs}} — they will be cancelled.
